Use case: illustration-story. Create an original fantasy companion portrait for Vesper Math. The attached vintage card illustrations are STYLE/MEDIUM REFERENCES only, not subjects to copy. Study their economy, soft incomplete edges and restrained painting. No card frame or text.
Elian is an adult woman cartographer with loosely waved chestnut hair, an unadorned faded teal cloak over an ivory tunic. Waist-up three-quarter view, quietly looking past the viewer, one hand resting on a loosely suggested folded map. An intelligent, beautiful but lived-in face, indicated with a few economical marks rather than idealized glamour. Behind her: pale grey-green suggestion of a lakeside arch, largely unpainted paper and soft shadow.
Medium: modest 1990s paperback fantasy illustration painted by hand in thin gouache and watercolor on ivory paper, a few irregular dark pencil/ink contours. Broad flat areas of color, uneven translucent pigment, simplified anatomy and folds. Let background shapes dissolve. Intimate, mysterious, understated. Limited sage, faded teal, umber and cream. Portrait 4:5.
Essential: this must look LESS finished and LESS detailed. Large calm shapes and interpretive empty space. No embroidery, jeweled bodice, decorative gold filigree, glowing particles, intricate hair strands, photographic skin, rendering-engine lighting, sparkling eyes, ornamental border, cute creatures, plastic digital gradients, or all-over crosshatching. Do not add simulated distress over a detailed rendering: the drawing itself should be spare.
